title: Budget Policy v1
description: VLM budget allocation policy with cell estimation and classification thresholds

budget_class.description: Budget classification based on estimated cells: small<36, typical≤120, large>120

est_rows.description: Estimated number of rows in the table

est_cols.description: Estimated number of columns in the table

est_cells.description: Clamped product of est_rows * est_cols, used for budget calculation

est_source.description: Source of cell estimation: vision_lines (primary), proj_peaks (fallback 1), default (fallback 2)

max_new_tokens.description: Computed token budget: clamp(384 + 10*min(est_cells,120), 256, 2048), adjusted for payer/density/retry

payer_multiplier.description: Optional payer class multiplier (e.g., 1.15 for dense EOBs)

retry_multiplier.description: Optional retry multiplier (1.25 for row-targeted retries)
